# vpsadmin_vps_user_data (Data Source)

Reads user data stored in vpsAdmin by its numeric ID. Raw content is not stored in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vpsadmin_vps_user_data" "bootstrap" {
  vps_user_data_id = 1234
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vps_user_data_id` (Number) ID of the stored user data

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 digest of the stored content
- `format` (String) Content format
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `label` (String) Label of the stored user data
